note: All visual assets. The app reads only this file; replace PNGs (same size) or edit entries to swap art.

provinciae.title: The provinces of the Empire (chapter I)

hero_base.desc: A young Roman in a cream tunic with a belt and sandals, dark hair. Sprite sheet, 6 columns x 4 rows of 16x24 frames. Columns: idle 0, idle 1, walk 0-3. Rows: facing down, up, left, right. Feet at the bottom-centre of each frame (anchor 8,23).

hero_toga.use: Map: outfit layer drawn over hero_base when equipped
hero_toga.desc: Overlay layer: white toga with a purple border (toga praetexta) draped over the tunic. Same frame layout as hero_base; transparent elsewhere.

hero_cloak.use: Map: outfit layer drawn over hero_base when equipped
hero_cloak.desc: Overlay layer: terracotta travelling cloak (paenula) with a gold clasp. Same frame layout as hero_base; transparent elsewhere.

hero_laurel.use: Map: outfit layer drawn over hero_base when equipped
hero_laurel.desc: Overlay layer: green laurel wreath on the head (final reward). Same frame layout as hero_base; transparent elsewhere.

hero_satchel.use: Map: outfit layer drawn over hero_base when equipped
hero_satchel.desc: Overlay layer: leather school satchel (capsa) on a strap. Same frame layout as hero_base; transparent elsewhere.

tile_via.use: Map: the stone-paved road (repeating texture along the path)
tile_via.desc: Seamless 32x32 tile of Roman basalt paving (polygonal blocks), grey with darker joints; no direction, so it sits under any curve.

bg_provinciae.use: Map background, district: The provinces of the Empire (chapter I)
bg_provinciae.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: an old parchment map-land: pale sand, faint contour specks.

bg_villa.use: Map background, district: The family villa and household
bg_villa.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: trimmed grass and garden borders around the villa.

bg_hortus.use: Map background, district: The garden (hortus) and peristyle
bg_hortus.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: lush garden ground with flowers (roses, lilies).

bg_via.use: Map background, district: The Via Latina toward Tusculum
bg_via.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: roadside meadow, dusty verges.

bg_taberna.use: Map background, district: The shops of Rome
bg_taberna.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: packed earth and paving in front of shops.

bg_rus.use: Map background, district: Farm and countryside
bg_rus.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: fields with furrows, pasture.

bg_silva.use: Map background, district: Forest of wild beasts
bg_silva.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: dark forest floor.

bg_castra.use: Map background, district: Army camp / frontier
bg_castra.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: trampled earth of a legionary camp.

bg_templa.use: Map background, district: Temples and the calendar

bg_ludus.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: stone floor of a schoolroom portico.

bg_mare.use: Map background, district: Harbor and open sea
bg_mare.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: sea water with small waves.

bg_urbs.use: Map background, district: Streets of Rome
bg_urbs.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: basalt street paving.

bg_creta.use: Map background, district: Crete and the Labyrinth (myth)
bg_creta.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: ochre Cretan earth.

bg_caelum.use: Map background, district: Cliffs and sky (Daedalus and Icarus)
bg_caelum.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: pale sky with clouds.

bg_triclinium.use: Map background, district: The dining room (banquet)
bg_triclinium.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: mosaic floor in deep reds.

bg_theatrum.use: Map background, district: Theater and circus
bg_theatrum.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: sand of the arena.

bg_forum.use: Map background, district: The Forum and the Capitol (finale)
bg_forum.desc: Seamless 64x64 ground tile: gleaming marble and gold-flecked paving.

prop_cypress.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: provinciae, villa, via, silva, templa
prop_cypress.desc: tall slender Italian cypress. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_pine.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: via, silva
prop_pine.desc: Italian umbrella (stone) pine. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_olive.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: provinciae, hortus, rus, creta
prop_olive.desc: olive tree, silvery leaves. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_bush.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: villa, hortus, silva
prop_bush.desc: low shrub with a few rose blossoms. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_column.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: villa, hortus, templa, ludus, urbs, creta, triclinium, theatrum, forum
prop_column.desc: single marble column. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_statue.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: hortus, templa, ludus, urbs, theatrum, forum
prop_statue.desc: marble statue on a plinth. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_house.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: taberna; Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: villa, via
prop_house.desc: small Roman house with terracotta roof. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_shop.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: taberna
prop_shop.desc: taberna (shop front) with striped awning and goods. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_sheep.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: rus
prop_sheep.desc: white sheep (pastor et ovēs). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_rock.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: provinciae, via, rus, silva, castra, mare, creta, caelum
prop_rock.desc: grey boulder. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_vine.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: rus
prop_vine.desc: grapevine on a stake with purple grapes. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_wheat.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: rus
prop_wheat.desc: sheaf of ripe wheat. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_boat.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: mare
prop_boat.desc: merchant ship with a square sail. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_wave.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: mare
prop_wave.desc: small wave crest (decor on water). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_tent.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: castra
prop_tent.desc: legionary goatskin tent, gable end on, with a red pennant. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_standard.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: castra
prop_standard.desc: legion standard (aquila) with red banner. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_amphora.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: villa, taberna, triclinium
prop_amphora.desc: clay amphora. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_bench.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: ludus
prop_bench.desc: school bench with a wax tablet. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_templum.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: forum; Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: provinciae, templa
prop_templum.desc: small temple facade. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_wall.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: castra
prop_wall.desc: crenellated stone wall segment. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_labyrinth.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: creta
prop_labyrinth.desc: stone slab carved with a labyrinth (Crete). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_cloud.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: caelum
prop_cloud.desc: small cloud. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_feather.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: caelum
prop_feather.desc: loose feather (Icarus). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_couch.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: triclinium
prop_couch.desc: dining couch (lectus triclinii). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_lamp.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: taberna, ludus, urbs, triclinium
prop_lamp.desc: standing oil lamp. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_mask.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: theatrum
prop_mask.desc: painted theatre mask on a short stone post. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_arena.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: theatrum
prop_arena.desc: small circus/arena oval. Anchor at bottom centre.

landmark_milestone.use: Map: every rest stop (one per week)
landmark_milestone.desc: Roman milestone (miliarium). `face` is its flat marble inscription field; the week number is carved there with font_roman, on two lines (tens above units) when it is too long for one. Anchor at bottom centre.

landmark_fountain.use: Map: rest stop (catch-up day), alternates with shrine
landmark_fountain.desc: public fountain with a basin and a spout. Anchor at bottom centre.

landmark_shrine.use: Map: rest stop (catch-up day), alternates with fountain
landmark_shrine.desc: small roadside shrine (lararium/aedicula) with a gilded image. Anchor at bottom centre.

landmark_arch.desc: triumphal arch spanning the road where the chapter changes; `face` is the marble panel in the gold frame on the attic, which takes the chapter numeral. Anchor at bottom centre.

landmark_capitolium.use: Map: final destination (end of chapter XXXV)
landmark_capitolium.desc: Temple of Jupiter on the Capitoline: wide steps, columns, gilded pediment. Anchor at bottom centre.

wp_locked.use: Map: waypoint marker on the road
wp_locked.desc: dim grey stepping stone (future day, locked).

wp_current.use: Map: waypoint marker on the road

wp_done.use: Map: waypoint marker on the road
wp_done.desc: terracotta stamped marker with a gold dot (completed day).

wp_rest.use: Map: waypoint marker on the road

coin_as.desc: A bronze as seen face-on, with a ship's prow.

coin_dupondius.desc: A brass dupondius seen face-on, with a radiate head.

coin_sestertius.desc: An orichalcum sestertius seen face-on, with a laureate head.

coin_quinarius.desc: A small silver quinarius seen face-on, with a winged Victory.

coin_denarius.desc: A silver denarius seen face-on, with a helmeted head.

coin_aureus.desc: A gold aureus seen face-on, with a laureate head.

icon_toga.desc: Icon: folded toga with purple border.

icon_streak.desc: Icon: small flame / hearth for the streak counter.

ui_frame.use: UI: 9-slice frame for chapter title cards and panels (8px slices)
ui_frame.desc: Parchment panel with a terracotta double border and gold corner studs. Must work as CSS border-image with 8px slices.

ui_tablet.use: Rewards screen: background of each collected chapter inscription
ui_tablet.desc: Marble inscription tablet (tabula ansata) with a carved inner border; text is overlaid by the app.

font_roman.use: Map: Roman numerals on milestones and arches
font_roman.desc: Bitmap font sheet: glyphs I V X L C D M in that order, ink on transparent, 7 high. Each glyph sits left-aligned in a cell; cells are `advance` (4) apart, so the sheet is 28x7. `widths` is each glyph's width and `gap` the space the app leaves between glyphs.

app_icon_180.desc: App icon: a laurel wreath around a cream letter L on a terracotta field, pixel-art style (24x24 art upscaled ×7 on a 180px field).

app_icon_192.desc: App icon: a laurel wreath around a cream letter L on a terracotta field, pixel-art style (24x24 art upscaled ×8).

app_icon_512.desc: App icon: a laurel wreath around a cream letter L on a terracotta field, pixel-art style (32x32 art upscaled ×16; the wreath stays inside the maskable safe zone).

prop_insula.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: taberna, urbs
prop_insula.desc: apartment block (insula): shops at street level, a timber balcony and three floors of small windows. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_insula_b.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: taberna, urbs
prop_insula_b.desc: smaller apartment block in bare brick with travertine string courses and an arched shop. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_domus.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: urbs
prop_domus.desc: town house (domus): blind street wall, tall doorway, the atrium roof with its open compluvium behind. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_thermae.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: urbs
prop_thermae.desc: public baths (thermae): vaulted hall with a lunette window, a domed hot room and a smoking furnace flue. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_basilica.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: forum
prop_basilica.desc: basilica: two storeys of marble arcades under a long tiled roof. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_pistrinum.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: taberna
prop_pistrinum.desc: bakery (pistrinum): brick oven with a fire, loaves on shelves, two lava millstones and a grain sack. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_tholos.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: forum; Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: templa
prop_tholos.desc: round temple (tholos, like the Temple of Vesta) with a conical roof. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_portico.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: urbs, forum
prop_portico.desc: a stretch of colonnade (porticus) under a tiled roof. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_aqueduct.use: Map: built in rows in the city districts: urbs
prop_aqueduct.desc: three arches of an aqueduct carrying its water channel; the arches are transparent. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_theatre.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: theatrum
prop_theatre.desc: theatre: the curved outer wall of the seating, two tiers of arcades below an attic. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_obelisk.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: theatrum
prop_obelisk.desc: red granite obelisk with a gilded tip, as on the spina of the Circus. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_columna.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: forum
prop_columna.desc: honorary column with a spiral of reliefs and a gilded statue on top. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_rostra.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: forum
prop_rostra.desc: the Rostra: speakers' platform hung with the bronze rams of captured ships. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_altar.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: templa, forum
prop_altar.desc: marble altar with a garland and a burning offering. Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_civis.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: taberna, urbs, theatrum, forum
prop_civis.desc: citizen in a toga, standing (static, facing the viewer). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_matrona.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: taberna, urbs, theatrum, forum
prop_matrona.desc: woman in a stola with her palla drawn over her head (static). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_mercator.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: taberna, urbs
prop_mercator.desc: street seller in a tunic carrying a tray of loaves on his head (static). Anchor at bottom centre.

prop_plaustrum.use: Map decoration scattered beside the road in districts: taberna, urbs
prop_plaustrum.desc: two-wheeled cart (plaustrum) loaded with amphorae. Anchor at bottom centre.
